_comment: B14: hand-reviewed research-context tags per investigation. Allowed tags: prevention, detection, suppression, unknown. Every tag other than 'unknown' needs evidence (document, page, verbatim quote) from the files shipped with the dataset. Tags group studies by research context; they do not certify fire-safety performance.
disclaimer: Research-context grouping only; it does not certify fire-safety performance of any material, atmosphere or system.

CFI (FLEX).rationale: The source presents cool flames as a re-ignition hazard to understand, which is fire-prevention context. No detection or suppression claim is made for these runs.

evidence.document: CFI_PSI-39/pdf/Cool Flames in Space, a Hot Prospect on Earth_CFI.pdf
evidence.quote: These cool flames produce partially oxidized fuel and potentially re-ignite to hot flames posing fire safety concerns in spacecraft environments

evidence.document: CFI_PSI-39/pdf/Cool Flames in Space, a Hot Prospect on Earth_CFI.pdf

ACME CFI-G.rationale: The documents shipped with PSI-159 (engineering implementation report, daily logs) describe hardware and operations; no statement tying CFI-G to fire prevention, detection or suppression was found in them.
